findings.description: RN-01 competing registry heading is retired; one visible registry identity remains.
RN-01 exposes visible-versus-total count semantics.
EC-01 competing registry heading is retired; one visible registry identity remains.
EC-01 exposes visible-versus-total count semantics.
Semantic scope Vista converges into the existing ControlRail rather than creating a competing control row.
Procedure purpose and material claim boundary remain distinct information roles.
Operational work remains before technical or explanatory planes.
Visible state values carry an explicit semantic state axis.
State meaning is encoded as text plus style and never color-only.
Process directory preserves canonical title hierarchy and row grammar.
Process CTA geometry is bounded while canonical click actionability is preserved.
Proof and reference disclosure rows preserve bounded readable geometry.
Command-palette results expose typed result kinds.
Command keyboard hints are explicit text or kbd semantics rather than ambiguous glyph-only instructions.
Standard Browser exposes content provenance and limitation for the selected node.
Official-public standards have a bounded complete versioned source-pack path distinct from licensed/reference paths.
ICTC does not manufacture protected standard text when authoritative text is unavailable.
MC-01 mapping is requirement-first and keeps proposal semantics explicit.
Standard Browser can hand a selected requirement into the mapping flow without creating a decision.
Null and missing secondary reason language does not amplify an absence into a stronger claim.
No new competing active primary/registry writer is introduced; the canonical Process Hub writer remains authoritative.
Responsive rails, dialogs and rows preserve action visibility and avoid local horizontal overflow.
Provider-specific request, response and authentication protocol mapping is first-class for OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek.
AI settings provide guided provider selection with safe defaults and an advanced custom path.
Provider health probe is authenticated, permission-gated and uses the same bounded AI call path.
Provider verification state is visible and becomes dirty after configuration changes.
A custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint remains configurable without becoming a parallel AI authority.
Network policy, budget reservation, schema validation and human-decision boundaries remain mandatory for provider calls.
